disable.description: Disable wide dynamic range. Equivalent to strength=0

enable.description: Enable Auto update of black level subtraction. When false, other parameters are ignored

gains.description: Gain levels for black level subtraction

enable.description: Enable auto update of color processing. When false, other parameters are ignored

gains.description: Gain levels for for color processing

auto_luma.description: Whether to automatically stretch Y channel (true = automatic Y stretch, false = manual)

histogram_equalization.description: Whether to apply histogram equalization on Y channel

denoise_method.description: The denoise filter family to use

manual_contrast.description: Manual contrast (Y channel)  stretching factor (1=no change, 2=double contrast)

auto_target_low.description: Auto luma stretches Y percentiles to fit between the low and high target bit numbers. This is the low target

bilateral_sigma.description: Bilateral filter sigma in the color space. Higher values mean that farther colors within the pixel neighborhood will be mixed together, resulting in larger areas of similar color.

sharpness_level.description: The spatial extent of the sharpness filter. Higher values result in finer texture being sharpened

histogram_equalization_clip_threshold.description: The threshold for clipping in the histogram equalization algorithm.

blur.description: Blur level of image (higher value means more blurred)

histogram_equalization_alpha.description: The coefficience between the previous LUT value (last frame)  and the new calculated LUT value (this frame)

sharpness_threshold.description: The threshold for edge detection for the sharpness filter. Lower values mean more texture but also more noise

manual_brightness.description: Brightness (Y channel)  addition (0=no change, positive=brighter image)

auto_percentile_high.description: Auto luma stretches Y to fit values between the low and high percentile of Y value. This is the high percentile.

auto_percentile_low.description: Auto luma stretches Y to fit values between the low and high percentile of Y value. This is the low percentile.

sharpness_amount.description: The strength of edge enhancement. Higher values mean stronger sharpening

auto_low_pass_filter_alpha.description: Auto luma applies low-pass filter on calculated brightness and contrast values from current and previous frames and biases the previous values. This is the bias

auto_target_high.description: Auto luma stretches Y percentiles to fit between the low and high target bit numbers. This is the high target
